title: cross-sdk-compact-connector-and-adaptive-retry-window-session-proto
author: Maya Chen
description: Align session token windowing and introduce a compact connector shim across Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs to improve streaming ergonomics and adaptive retry behavior. This PR unifies session semantics (lease/refresh), adds a RetryWindow config that reduces thundering reauth during transient auth flaps, and provides a lightweight CompactConnector interface that normalizes handshake/stream resume behavior across languages. Also includes parity fixes for streaming cursor APIs and small ergonomics improvements to client constructors. Motivation: customer incidents where simultaneous renewals caused elevated 5xx and spiky latency for short bursts; aim to make client behavior safer by default while keeping opt-out knobs. CHANGELOGs updated and examples migrated. Checklist: [x] cross-language spec and tests added [x] docs/migration notes [x] unit+integration tests [x] bump SDK versions (py->0.23.1, ts->1.7.0, go->0.10.0) [ ] follow-up: telemetry rename in a separate PR.
